nodes.description: BigBang.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns its result.
internal view whitelist gate: returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale[_from], otherwise requires condition(_from,_value); computes pair via pairFor.
public payable transfer; subtracts allowance and balances without SafeMath and gates via ensure().
public payable approve; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
internal view anti-bot/honeypot check on _onSaleNum[_from], _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
public payable owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary attacker supplied address and payload.
public owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
public payable owner-only mass transfer loop with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance arithmetic.
public owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress.
internal pure Uniswap-V2 style pair address computation using create2 formula and hardcoded init code hash.
payable constructor: mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner = msg.sender and unlimited UNI allowance.
address private owner; privileged account used by every onlyOwner check and whitelist branch.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address bypassing the trading restriction in ensure().
mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum; per-account sale counter incremented on each transferFrom and checked in condition().
mapping(address=>bool) canSale; per-account bypass flag checked in ensure().
uint256 _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced in condition().
uint256 _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced in condition().
uint256 _saleNum; maximum allowed number of sales per account enforced in condition().
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals mutated with unchecked subtraction.
uint public totalSupply; set once in the constructor.
string public name; token name set in constructor.
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor.
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used by constructor and init().
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure() and pre-approved in constructor.
msg.sender; user-controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance keys and recipient/spender resolution.
address _to parameter of BigBang.transfer; transfer recipient.
uint _value parameter of BigBang.transfer; amount forwarded to transferFrom.
address _from parameter of ensure(); whitelist subject and condition() argument.
address _to parameter of ensure(); checked against owner.
uint _value parameter of ensure(); forwarded into condition().
address _from parameter of transferFrom; debited account and allowance owner.
address _to parameter of transferFrom; credited account.
uint _value parameter of transferFrom; amount moved with unchecked arithmetic.
address _spender parameter of approve; allowance key.
uint _value parameter of approve; allowance amount.
address _from parameter of condition(); indexed into _onSaleNum.
uint _value parameter of condition(); compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
address a parameter of delegate(); target of the low-level delegatecall.
bytes b parameter of delegate(); calldata executed in the context of this contract.
uint256 saleNum parameter of init(); assigned to _saleNum.
uint256 token parameter of init(); scaled into _minSale.
uint256 maxToken parameter of init(); scaled into _maxSale.
address[] _tos parameter of batchSend(); loop bounds and unchecked length multiplication.
uint _value parameter of batchSend(); per-recipient amount.
address addr parameter of setTradeAddress(); stored into tradeAddress.
address factory parameter of pairFor(); hashed into the pair address.
address tokenA parameter of pairFor(); sorted against tokenB.
address tokenB parameter of pairFor(); sorted against tokenA.
string _name constructor parameter assigned to name.
string _symbol constructor parameter assigned to symbol.
uint256 _supply constructor parameter scaled into totalSupply.
address _UNI local in ensure() holding the computed pair address used in the whitelist branch.
uint total local in batchSend() computed as _value * _tos.length.
uint i loop counter in batchSend().
address _to local in batchSend() loop holding the current recipient.
address token0 local in pairFor(); lower-address token of the sorted pair.
address token1 local in pairFor(); higher-address token of the sorted pair.
address pair return variable in pairFor() computed from the create2 hash.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context, enabling full storage takeover.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; underflows silently on Solidity 0.5.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; unchecked wrap-around.
batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total with no overflow/underflow protection.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards _to and _value to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns its boolean.
transferFrom() calls require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)) before mutating balances.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)).
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted accounts.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner whitelist.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure() whitelists _from when it equals tradeAddress.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale restriction.
transfer() consumes the _to parameter as the recipient.
transfer() consumes the _value parameter as the amount.
ensure() parameter _from feeds the whitelist checks and condition().
ensure() parameter _to is compared with owner.
ensure() parameter _value is passed to condition().
transferFrom() parameter _from is the debited account and allowance owner.
transferFrom() parameter _to is the credited account.
transferFrom() parameter _value is the amount moved.
approve() parameter _spender keys the allowance mapping.
approve() parameter _value is stored as the allowance.
condition() parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum.
condition() parameter _value is bounds-checked against _minSale/_maxSale.
delegate() parameter a is the delegatecall target.
delegate() parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
init() parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
init() parameter token is scaled by decimals and stored into _minSale.
init() parameter maxToken is scaled by decimals and stored into _maxSale.
batchSend() parameter _tos provides the recipients and loop bound.
batchSend() parameter _value is the per-recipient amount.
setTradeAddress() parameter addr is written into tradeAddress.
pairFor() parameter factory is hashed into the create2 pair computation.
pairFor() parameter tokenA is sorted against tokenB.
pairFor() parameter tokenB is sorted against tokenA.
constructor parameter _name is assigned to name.
constructor parameter _symbol is assigned to symbol.
constructor parameter _supply is scaled into totalSupply.
local _UNI in ensure() receives the pairFor result and is used in the whitelist branch.
local total in batchSend() holds the aggregate debit amount.
local total is the product of _value and _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
local i drives the batchSend() recipient loop.
local _to in batchSend() receives each credited address.
local token0 participates in the pairFor() create2 hash.
local token1 participates in the pairFor() create2 hash.
local pair is the returned address computed by pairFor().
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom() trusts msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and deduction.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked allowance subtraction reachable by any caller.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve() keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() compares _value with _minSale.
condition() compares _value with _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-account sale cap.
delegate() gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner) which resolves through _msgSender()/msg.sender.
delegate() performs an external delegatecall to an arbitrary address, executing foreign code that can reenter and overwrite this contract's storage.
init() is reachable only when msg.sender equals owner.
init() writes the scaled minimum sale amount into _minSale.
init() writes the scaled maximum sale amount into _maxSale.
init() writes the per-account sale cap into _saleNum.
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] for each recipient.
batchSend() performs unchecked multiplication and balance subtraction that can be abused by the owner to craft inconsistent state.
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes addr into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
constructor derives ownership and initial supply from msg.sender.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply argument.
constructor pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1) allowance.
owner state variable is read by the delegate() access check.
owner state variable is read by the init() access check.
owner state variable is read by the batchSend() access check.
owner state variable is read by the setTradeAddress() access check.
